name: Delayed Blast Fireball

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

components.m: a ball of bat guano and sulfur

upcast.text: The starting damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 7.

summary: A bead of fire that bursts in a 20-foot-radius Sphere when the spell ends: Dex save, 12d6 Fire plus 1d6 per turn it waited (half on a success).
text: A glowing bead hangs at a point in range until the spell ends, then bursts: each creature within 20 feet of it makes a Dexterity save, taking the stored Fire damage on a failure or half on a success. The damage starts at 12d6 and grows by 1d6 at the end of each of your turns; a creature that touches the bead first makes a Dexterity save, setting it off on a failure or throwing it up to 40 feet on a success. Higher slots add 1d6 to the starting damage per level above 7.
